title: Basa Muguta Rekare
intro: Guta rekare rine guruva, vanhu varo vakaramba zvakasimba, uye yambiro yekupedzisira isina kuteererwa. Nhasi, pinda mubasa reavo vakatumwa naAllah kuti vaendese shoko kuvanhu vakaoma musoro. Nyaya yekurambwa, inzwi rekutenda rimwe chete, uye mugumo wakasimbiswa nemurairo unoparadza. Ndiani anotaura kuburikidza nezviratidzo izvi?
clues: Takatumwa naAllah kuguta rine vanhu vakanga vatsauka kubva pachokwadi.
Vaviri vedu ndivo vakatanga kuuya, uye wechitatu akabatana kuti tisimbise basa redu
Vanhu vemutaundi vakatiramba, vachiti takanga tiri vanhu vakaita saivo chete
Mumwe munhu aibva kumagumo eguta akamhanya kunoudza vanhu kuti vatitevere
Takavakumbira ruregerero, asi vakaomesa mwoyo yavo vakatipandukira
Mukuchema kumwe chete kunorwadza kubva kudenga, guta redu rese rakanyaradzwa

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Akarambwa uye akanzi varevi venhema nevanhu vemuguta
Kupiswa vari vapenyu mumoto mukuru unopfuta
Kumanikidzwa kushanda nesimba kuvaka mbiru refu
trial.answer: Akarambwa uye akanzi varevi venhema nevanhu vemuguta

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Guta rakaparadzwa nekuchema kumwe chete kunoparadza (Sayha)
Mudzvinyiriri neuto rake vakanyura mugungwa rakakamurwa
Mvura yematombo yakabva kudenga yakaparadza guta
Mafashamo ane simba akaparadza nharaunda yese
outcome.answer: Guta rakaparadzwa nekuchema kumwe chete kunoparadza (Sayha)

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
